title: Mixed Event — Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness! — Episode6 Be The Bride You Want To Be

meta.Event: Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness!
meta.Episode: Episode6 — Be The Bride You Want To Be
meta.Event Outline: A photographer who is a regular at the cafe asks An if she would be her bridal model. An, who cares deeply about those around her, pushes past her embarrassment and accepts. At the wedding venue, An encounters another bridal model—Shizuku.

rows.Line: Wedding Ceremony Hall - Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
Even after looking at my poses and facial expressions, I still can't tell what I'm doing wrong...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm tense? What did she mean by that...? I thought I managed to shake off any nerves...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But if I somehow manage to be like that one bride I saw...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Argh...!
I just don't know anymore!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Why'd Ms. Kawasaki have to choose me to play the bride...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She wanted to take pictures of someone with this brilliant spark of life, so I feel like Shizuku would've been the better option...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But there's no point in me dwelling on that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try taking a video of myself on my phone! That might show me what I'm missing...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I know I can't make any huge changes in just one day, but I want things to end on a high note somehow...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I have to do what I can to produce the perfect shot!)
Outside the chapel

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hmm... An still hasn't returned.
I'm starting to get worried.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, you two looked really good when Ms. Kawasaki was taking pictures of you both just now. I wonder why she seems so dissatisfied...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: About that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: An unprecedented event which turned into this legendary night that nobody thinks anyone will ever surpass. But that's what my team's trying to do!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to keep trying to be as real a bride as I can...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, I'm going to go for a little bit to see An! There's something I need to check right now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, wait...! Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wedding Ceremony Hall - Waiting Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
An should be...
Oh...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, this isn't right either...!
Does that mean the problem's my expressions and not the way I'm posing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought presenting myself as being mature would make me seem like a real bride, but maybe I should be going for “wishing for my partner's happiness” instead...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
An certainly seems like the hard-working type who likes to take everything she does seriously.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I can tell why she and Haruka are such good friends.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And what I can do for her right now is...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: An, do you have a minute...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, Shizuku...!
Is our break over already?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, we still have time.
So, I'd like to talk with you for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Talk?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think I understand why you seem a little tense right now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
Please tell me, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Can you start by posing for me...? And smile like the photographer's here taking photos of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Wish for my partner's happiness...
Calm and gentle like a real bride...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ah, I knew it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: An, what sort of expression were you trying to make just now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um... My image of a bride involves someone who's overjoyed about getting married but remains collected while having this air of maturity about her...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I thought I have to be just like that person...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “You have to”...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really don't think there's any need to restrict yourself like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I really don't think plain old me is all that suited to being a bride...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Try to remember why Ms. Kawasaki asked you to play the bride, An. What made her choose you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... She mentioned some stuff about being photogenic and having presence...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, she also said that I always have this “brilliant spark”...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I felt just that when we chatted a little earlier, An.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your eyes sparkled as you told me all about that incredible event you're trying to surpass.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure Ms. Kawasaki's goal was to capture that part of you, An. The you that's so full of hope.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your image of a bride being mature, calm and collected is certainly a lovely thought.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But that's not who you are, An.
By acting like someone you're not, I believe you're preventing that spark of yours from coming to the surface.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, there are those who excel at acting, but we want to see you just being yourself, An. There's no need to fill someone else's shoes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Now I get it...
I got all caught up in filling that bride's shoes even after Ms. Kawasaki said that she wanted to see me be me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
I convinced myself somewhere along the way that I had “to be as real a bride as I can”.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's no need to apologize. I'm sure everybody has a role model they look up to and work very hard towards emulating.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you don't have to do that, An, because you already have such a wonderful gift.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That spark inside of you. The powerful will that's driving you towards making your dreams a reality.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe... Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna stop trying to be “that bride” I placed on a pedestal and just be “An Shiraishi the bride”!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wonderful! Let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Still, that's so amazing...!
You immediately figuring out what my problem was is like proof that you're a real model!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How did you know so quickly?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That may be because I also had to play a certain role...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Back when I was still in Cheerful * Days, I really never had any confidence in myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It constantly felt like I was falling short because everyone had such high expectations of me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That was when the producer started writing detailed scripts for me and asked me to simply read the lines I was given...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All in order to play the role of the “perfect Shizuku Hinomori”...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I had a feeling you were going through the same thing, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sorry. I know it's not a very happy story.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But as painful as that time was for me, I'm glad that I'm able to put those experiences to good use...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There are just some things you can only learn after not having much confidence in yourself...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you seem to be very comfortable with yourself now, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've actually been watching the MORE MORE JUMP! streams from time to time and you always seem so full of energy, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can't get those kinds of expressions just by acting.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You seem at ease with yourself...
And can keep making strides because you know exactly “who you want to be”!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Who I want to be...?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I really admire how hard she works.>
<Me too. She's a beauty on stage but has to work really hard to be that way.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
It certainly feels like I've been on the right path.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There's still plenty that I'm not very good at, but I want to keep doing my best to be an idol who can spread hope to others...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, I want to become someone that those who I care deeply about and have been there for me can be proud of...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Someone who they can be proud of...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That means we're the same!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What? You too, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yes!
Me, Kohane, everyone on our team, the ones who take our thoughts and feeling seriously, and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Everybody in town who's always there to support us. I want to become someone they can all be proud of!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No matter how hard they are, I have to keep taking on whatever challenges are thrown at me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's just be ourselves and do what we can to help Ms. Kawasaki capture the moment when “happiness brings everybody together”.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What if we both wished for each other “to be who we want to be”?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: By rooting for each other as we pursue our goals, I have a feeling that the moment when “happiness brings everybody together” will arise really naturally...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's a wonderful idea...!
Let's try that, An!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was wondering what she ran off to talk about all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you've become such a good role model, Shizuku.
